scope: Stage 3.0 only; no method-set trim or Stage 3.1 work

methodology.synthetic: Existing goway_synthetic.py generate, N=10 and N=20, seed=1, 40 handlers and 5 reports per style. Build only new, sequentially, GOMAXPROCS=4, go build -p=2 -toolexec=<existing native time wrapper> ./...; go list -export with identical flags; stream go tool nm T/t symbols. Task GOCACHE reused: these are archive size/function counts and per-compiler maximum RSS, not cold wall-time measurements.
methodology.attribution: Elide balanced generic argument brackets in nm names; group by package and generic origin. Pointer methods are (*T).M symbols. Baseline promoted methods are those inherited from Column/ordered/NullableColumn/nullableOrdered; value and pointer promotions reported separately. Final column methods are all direct, independently enforced by go/types. Counts include concrete and go.shape instantiations; not unique source functions.
methodology.benchmarks: Six runs each, before then after, same machine/default Go benchmark settings, no competing task builds. Medians and ranges retained; no speedup claim. Consumer InsertCompile skips because compiler is private; new internal BenchmarkInsertCompile measures actual planWrite plus compilation, with SQL/binding success checks. No execution or I/O included.
methodology.load_average: Start 3.76/4.19/6.19; after measurements 3.33/3.49/3.74. 16 logical CPUs. Other machine workload was not controlled.

candidates.name: 1 flatten
candidates.mechanism: Every kind declares direct shells; columnData/nullableColumnData store method-free state. Remove ordered/nullableOrdered and embedded public Column. Distinct private field names and a zero-size model marker retain kind/model conversion restrictions. Existing comparison, order, assignment, adjustment and codec logic stays shared. Rows/expr were already flat.

candidates.name: 2 private bridge
candidates.mechanism: KeyColumn.ormColumn returns method-free typed state, rather than another public Column. This removes the transitive public Column method set. The public relation call shapes remain unchanged; unavoidable public interface boundaries remain.

candidates.name: 2 interface/non-generic adapter/reflection triggers
candidates.mechanism: A minimal package instantiating real orm.Number retains 32 pointer wrappers even with only a typed function parameter, without reflection or conversion to interface. A non-generic function adapter does not reduce them. Keep Define reflection because it validates attachment, foreign/unassigned embedded tables and method shadows. Pointer-only public receivers would remove methods from value method sets and break returned-value calls; positive probes pin table.Key(), NumberKey/TextKey and query chains.

candidates.name: 3 Codec and Optional sharing
candidates.mechanism: Codec/Optional themselves were already single-parameter Codec[V] and Optional[V]. Counts and concrete instantiation inventories are identical before/after; scalar string/int64 instantiations are shared. Remaining model growth is for distinct model.ID[M] / Optional[M] value types, not an extra independent model parameter. No codec/Optional rewrite. However bindTyped, bindNullable and columnWithCodec carried an unused M parameter, duplicating codec-construction closures per model/value shape. Move M markers to public handles and the private ormColumn(*M) argument; those state builders and expression adapters now depend only on V.

candidates.name: 4 method-set trim
candidates.mechanism: Not authorized. Proposed approval discussion: move Ne, NotIn, Between and specialized text prefix/suffix/insensitive matches to package functions while retaining core Eq/In/Set/order/range methods. This changes completion and requires explicit API approval and remeasurement; no promised RSS saving.
